verdict.rationale: A direct probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at developers.docusign.com/llms.txt), and the candidate OpenAPI paths on the developer site also 404. The closest substitutes are OpenAPI specs published on GitHub, which Docusign says let 'both humans and computers' discover the service's capabilities, plus first-party MCP server documentation and agent connector guides. These are machine-readable or agent-focused resources, but they are not docs built for agents to read directly. Missing for 10: llms.txt or llms-full.txt, OpenAPI spec served from the developer site, docs formatted for LLM consumption (e.g., markdown exports), independent corroboration of agents successfully using the docs.
